channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A força da mobilização bolsonarista contra Moraes e o STF, após decisão sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision to suspend Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to his father for 90 days during the electoral campaign triggered over 18 million social media posts in 18 hours, with 84.7% of analyzed expressions criticizing the STF and the minister. The episode demonstrates how judicial rulings rapidly become fuel for digital political narratives, driven by Bolsonarist mobilization ahead of the 2026 party conventions.

item.title: O mais votado vence? Entenda como funciona a eleição de deputado no Brasil
item.description: In Brazil's deputy elections, the open-list proportional system allocates seats based on electoral and party quotients, not solely on individual candidate votes. This allows smaller parties to gain representation, reflecting societal diversity. The most-voted candidate does not automatically win a seat, as distribution depends on the party's overall performance.

item.title: FPBio e entidades entregam a Lula carta em defesa da adoção imediata do B17
item.description: The Parliamentary Front for Biodiesel (FPBio) and biodiesel supply chain entities delivered a letter to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urging the immediate adoption of B17 — a 17% biodiesel blend in fossil diesel — to strengthen the sector, reduce emissions, and ensure energy security. The letter was handed over on Monday, the 13th, in São Paulo, as part of broader efforts to push the federal government to accelerate the energy transition in transportation.

item.title: OAB defende no STF direito de Flávio visitar Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Council of the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) filed a petition with the STF requesting the guarantee of confidential communication between lawyer and client, defending Flávio Bolsonaro’s right to visit former President Jair Bolsonaro after Justice Alexandre de Moraes barred such visits for 90 days. The OAB emphasized its technical and non-partisan role, stating that no lawyer can be prevented from defending a client regardless of familial ties or political affiliation. The request followed Flávio’s formal registration as his father’s lawyer in March to enable in-person meetings.

item.title: OAB pede que Moraes autorize Flávio a visitar Bolsonaro como advogado
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) requested that Minister Alexandre de Moraes allow Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as his lawyer, arguing that the 90-day ban on personal visits should not obstruct professional contact necessary for his defense. The OAB stressed its institutional role in defending lawyers' prerogatives, without interfering in the merits of the criminal case or the court's measures.

item.title: Selo do TSE para pesquisa eleitoral gera divergência entre institutos
item.description: The TSE proposed an 'Electoral Accuracy Seal' to reward polling institutes whose estimates closely match official results, but the initiative sparked division: Abep-affiliated institutes opposed it, while others like AtlasIntel supported it, stressing the need to define clear parameters. The court will accept suggestions until Friday (July 17) and emphasized that changes to electoral rules require careful analysis and will only be implemented when absolutely necessary.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: Institutos dizem que proposta de Nunes Marques 'confunde ciência com bola de cristal'
item.description: The ABEP criticized the TSE's proposal to create a seal for polling institutes whose surveys come closest to official election results, stating it confuses science with crystal ball gazing. The association argued that polls measure voter intent at the time of data collection and do not predict future outcomes, as voter opinions can change. It also warned the seal could create a 'perverse incentive,' encouraging less rigorous institutes to manipulate numbers to match consensus, undermining information quality.

item.title: Caiado sobre Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Liderança você não herda, liderança você cria'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, pré-presidential candidate from the PSD, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for relying on his father Jair Bolsonaro’s support in his campaign, stating that 'leadership is not inherited, it is created'. He argued that a presidential candidate must demonstrate independent capacity to handle crises without familial backing, and said this debate distracts from priority issues like health, education, and national sovereignty. Caiado also accused the Lula government of having 'delivered everything to the Comando Vermelho and the PCC', and criticized both Lula and his opponents for exploiting political conflict instead of discussing substantive policy.

item.title: Trump volta atrás em taxa de 20% sobre carga de navios no Estreito de Ormuz
item.description: President Donald Trump announced he will replace the 20% fee on ship cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz, announced the previous day, with commercial and investment agreements with Gulf nations. The measure had been criticized by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who called it 'piracy'. The reversal follows international pressure and concerns over global trade impacts.

item.title: Quem ficou preso melhor, Lula ou Bolsonaro?
item.description: The suspension of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, has sparked comparisons between the imprisonments of Lula and Bolsonaro, with Bolsonaro supporters emphasizing that Lula had greater access to communication while detained in the PF cell in Curitiba. Lula was convicted for corruption and money laundering, while Bolsonaro faces investigation for alleged coup attempt following the 2022 elections. The debate highlights polarization over legal treatment and detention conditions of political leaders.

item.title: Entorno de Michelle aposta em maior protagonismo após decisão de Moraes, enquanto aliados de Flávio defendem nova tentativa de reaproximação
item.description: The decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ban Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting Jair Bolsonaro for 90 days has opened space for Michelle Bolsonaro to gain greater prominence in the presidential campaign, as she maintains direct access to the former president, while Flávio’s allies hope for a future rapprochement. The ruling followed Moraes’ finding that Flávio used visitation rights to obtain a letter intended for social media dissemination, circumventing Bolsonaro’s ban on digital platform use. Michelle, who lives with the former president, is integrated into the PL leadership and faces no judicial restrictions, making her a natural conduit to maintain communication with Bolsonaro during Flávio’s absence.

item.title: Base de Lula aciona TSE e acusa Flávio de propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The PT-PV-PCdoB federation filed a complaint with the TSE against PL’s pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, alleging illegal early electioneering during a live stream where he asked for votes, displayed his ballot number, presented campaign proposals, and attacked President Lula. The broadcast also featured a letter from Jair Bolsonaro, prompting Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ban Flávio from visiting his imprisoned father until after the first round. The coalition demands the video be removed from YouTube within 24 hours and seeks fines.

item.title: Ex-candidata a vereadora em SP, Zilu Camargo tem contas de campanha rejeitadas e deverá devolver R$ 100 mil ao Tesouro
item.description: São Paulo’s Electoral Justice rejected the campaign accounts of Zilu Camargo, former 2024 city council candidate for União Brasil, ordering her to return R$ 100 thousand to the National Treasury due to an invalid service contract lacking the contractor’s signature. Her campaign received approximately R$ 1.8 million in public funds but failed to timely submit financial reports, including a R$ 550 thousand party donation, and irregularly contracted a political marketing firm for R$ 316.6 thousand after the audit deadline. Despite her appeal, Judge Cecilia Pinheiro da Fonseca upheld the ruling, backed by the Electoral Prosecutor’s Office, which deemed the flaws substantive and damaging to financial traceability.

item.title: Agro insiste em teto maior para renegociação de dívidas rurais
item.description: The Agricultural Parliamentary Front (FPA) and the federal government are negotiating the ceiling for rural debt renegotiation by CPF, with the Ministry of Finance advocating for R$ 8 million and the agribusiness bloc pushing for R$ 10 million. Bill PL 5.122/2023, already approved by the Senate, has an estimated impact of R$ 140 billion over 13 years, according to Senator Jaime Bagattoli (PL-RO), who argues the limit must reflect climate-related losses and commodity volatility. He stated that judicialization of the proposal is not the main concern at this time.

item.title: Entrevista: Mourão diz que Flávio precisa prestar contas de Dark Horse e crítica ala bolsonarista ligada a Eduardo e Paulo Figueiredo: ‘Não passa no psicotécnico’
item.description: Hamilton Mourão criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign as 'very turbulent', demanding accountability for financier Daniel Vorcaro's funding of the Dark Horse film tied to Jair Bolsonaro. He also attacked Bolsonarist allies like Paulo Figueiredo, saying they 'don’t pass the psychotechnical exam of the Detran', and questioned internal unity despite Jair Bolsonaro's letter of support for Flávio.

item.title: Zema classifica como 'perseguição política' decisão de Moraes que suspendeu visitas de Flávio a Bolsonaro
item.description: Romeu Zema labeled the decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to suspend Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to Jair Bolsonaro as 'political persecution,' claiming the Court is dysfunctional and acting as a political tribunal. He drew a parallel to when Lula was imprisoned and communicated with allies, accusing the STF of double standards. Zema also criticized the Court for alleged ties to Banco Master and argued that such rulings inadvertently bolster Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy.

item.title: Por que o PIX se tornou um foco da ofensiva comercial de Trump contra o Brasil?
item.description: The PIX, Brazil's instant payment system developed by the Central Bank, has become a focal point of a trade dispute between Brazil and the United States, with Washington accusing Brasília of favoring a state-run system that disadvantages U.S. credit card companies. The U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) is considering imposing 25% tariffs on part of Brazil's exports over alleged discriminatory policies, including PIX. Despite the criticism, PIX is widely popular in Brazil, used by 80% of the population and accounting for 54% of transactions, promoting financial inclusion and enjoying support from over 90% of Brazilians.

item.title: Nunes Marques quer ‘selo de qualidade’ para institutos de pesquisa que acertarem mais resultados eleitorais
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques proposed an 'Electoral Accuracy Seal' for polling institutes that produce results closest to actual election outcomes. The seal would be honorary, awarded every four years after the presidential runoff, and carries no official methodological certification or legal advantages. Institutes convicted of fraudulent polling or irregularities with final judgments would be ineligible.

item.title: Presidente do TSE anuncia proposta de premiação a institutos de pesquisa que mais acertarem os resultados das eleições
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques announced a proposal to create an electoral accuracy seal to reward polling institutes that most accurately predict election results. The proposal was presented in a meeting with 16 research institutes following the June suspension of an AtlasIntel poll. Institutes have until July 17 to submit contributions that will help define the award criteria.

item.title: Nunes Marques, do TSE, propõe criação de selo de acurácia para institutos de pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: Minister Kássio Nunes Marques of the TSE proposed the creation of an "accuracy seal" for electoral polling institutes, to be awarded to companies with the highest accuracy rates in predicting election results. The proposal was presented in a meeting with directors of 19 polling institutes on Tuesday morning, aiming to enhance the reliability and quality of public opinion surveys in Brazil.

item.title: Eduardo pede volta de Magnitsky após Moraes suspender visitas de Flávio a Bolsonaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro called for the reinstatement of Magnitsky sanctions against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes after Moraes suspended visits from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to jailed former President Jair Bolsonaro. Eduardo argued that banning communication between a prisoner and his presidential candidate son undermines the legitimacy of Brazil’s 2026 elections in the eyes of free nations. Moraes had blocked the visits after Flávio shared a letter from Jair endorsing his candidacy, which the minister deemed illicit early campaigning.

item.title: Ala do governo Lula aponta erro em decisão de Moraes contra Flávio
item.description: An Lula-aligned faction argues that Minister Alexandre de Moraes’ decision to ban Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting his father for 90 days was poorly grounded, claiming the dissemination of Jair Bolsonaro’s letter should not be the main basis. They propose that a stronger legal justification would be Flávio’s alleged involvement in the Master Case, related to a film about the ex-president, which could create a conflict with the ongoing investigation.

item.title: Sabesp privatizada repassou R$ 3,6 bilhões para 220 municípios, diz gestão Tarcísio
item.description: The privatized Sabesp has distributed R$3.6 billion to 220 municipalities in São Paulo since privatization, according to Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ administration. However, 151 of the 371 eligible municipalities have not yet qualified to receive the funds.

item.title: Caiado apresenta queixa-crime contra Boulos
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) filed a criminal complaint at the STF against Minister Guilherme Boulos for slander, insult, and defamation, after a video in which Boulos linked Caiado to an alleged organized crime scandal in Goiás. Caiado denies any connection to the investigated contracts involving the Pró-Cerrado Foundation and claims Boulos constructed a false narrative. The lawsuit seeks to hold Boulos accountable for statements that, according to the defense, lack basis in ongoing investigations.

item.title: TSE propõe criar um selo de qualidade para institutos de pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The TSE is discussing the creation of a 'accuracy' quality seal for electoral research institutes, aiming to reward those whose results most closely match actual election outcomes. While 11 institutes support the proposal, representatives from Datafolha, Quaest, Ipec, Ipesp, and MDA oppose it, arguing that polls reflect only a moment in time and long-term results are unpredictable. The debate follows a decision by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the broadcast of an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro over concerns about methodological neutrality.

item.title: Nunes Marques propõe selo para institutos de pesquisa com mais acertos dos resultados eleitorais
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques proposed a 'accuracy seal' for polling institutes with the highest election result accuracy, to be awarded after the second round based on polls conducted in the seven days before and on election day. The proposal excludes firms convicted of serious irregularities and has raised concerns among institutes about the temporal cutoff, as polls reflect a moment, not necessarily the final outcome. The meeting followed the suspension of an AtlasIntel poll over voter induction suspicions, and the TSE emphasized it does not intend to evaluate methodologies, only outcomes.

item.title: Dino diz que ex-parlamentares não podem controlar emendas e declara ‘cessões’ ilegais
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino declared illegal the 'cessions' of parliamentary amendments to former lawmakers and party leaders, stating that only elected deputies and senators can indicate amendments to the federal budget. The decision comes amid investigations involving Valdemar Costa Neto and Eduardo Cunha, reinforcing that parliamentary prerogatives cannot be informally transferred.

item.title: Bacellar nunca cogitou delação, diz defesa
item.description: The defense of former deputy Rodrigo Bacellar denies he is negotiating a plea bargain, stating he never considered cooperating with investigators. Bacellar was transferred from Bangu 8 prison to the federal penitentiary in Mossoró by order of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, due to concerns he could use his institutional influence in Rio de Janeiro. His detention stems from the TSE’s cancellation of his mandate over abuse of political and economic power in the Ceperj case, part of Operation Unha e Carne.

item.title: Desconhecimento da história, diz diretor da Fundação FHC após fala de Janja
item.description: Sergio Fausto, director-general of the FHC Foundation, described First Lady Janja’s remarks about the role of first ladies in Brazil as a 'lack of historical knowledge.' He argued her comments ignored the historical legacy of presidential spouses, particularly their institutional and symbolic roles. The statement emerged amid public debate over the visibility and influence of first ladies in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Bolsonaro é perseguido político ao qual negam o direito de ver o filho
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspended Flávio Bolsonaro’s 90-day visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, after the latter’s supportive letter was released, citing premature election campaigning. The decision is criticized as politically selective, recalling that Lula received hundreds of visits in prison in 2018, including media interviews and his lawyer (now a STF minister) reading letters on camera. The text accuses the judiciary of applying the law leniently to allies and harshly to opponents, especially during election periods.

item.title: A ‘goleada’ do vídeo de Michelle contra a carta de Jair a Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: A video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating her achieved significantly greater reach and engagement than the open letter from former President Jair Bolsonaro to his son, according to Nexus Institute research. On X, the video generated 240% more views and 132% more interactions than the letter, with 3.9 million interactions across X, Facebook, and Instagram. Jair Bolsonaro's call to 'set aside possible differences' and support Flávio reflects the challenges facing the candidacy amid Lula's lead in polls and internal far-right divisions.

item.title: TSE propõe avaliação de resultados de pesquisas pós-eleição
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques proposed the Electoral Accuracy Seal to reward polling firms whose estimates closely match official election results. The proposal, open for suggestions until July 17, 2026, would apply to polls released publicly, on election day, or up to seven days before, excluding firms sanctioned for irregularities. It is linked to a stalled case involving a Quaest poll on Flávio Bolsonaro’s alleged fundraising for the 'Dark Horse' biopic, with judgment suspended after a request for review by Minister Estela Aranha.

item.title: Justiça condena deputado do PL a indenizar PT por associar partido ao narcotráfico
item.description: The Federal District Court ordered federal deputy Paulo Bilynskyj (PL-SP) to pay R$15,000 in moral damages to the Workers' Party (PT) for falsely associating the party and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva with drug trafficking in social media posts. The ruling found the claims to be baseless and harmful to the PT’s reputation.

item.title: Dino vê ‘terceirização de emendas’ e cobra do governo Lula critérios mais rígidos de transparência
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino denounced a 'market for the outsourcing or privatization of parliamentary amendments,' calling it an unconstitutional violation of morality, legality, and purpose. He ordered the Lula government to adopt stricter criteria for traceability, transparency, and control over amendments following investigations that found Valdemar Costa Neto (PL president) and Eduardo Cunha (former Chamber speaker) allegedly directing funds without holding elective office, leading to asset freezes by the PF. Both deny wrongdoing.

item.title: Planalto já conta com novo tarifaço de Trump e calibra reação
item.description: The Lula administration is preparing for an inevitable 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, stemming from a formal USTR investigation launched in July 2025 over alleged unfair trade practices. The government will wait for the official publication of the measure, expected July 15, 2026, to determine the affected sectors and potential exceptions before deciding on a response, including reciprocity. Pix, ethanol, and trade agreements with Mexico and China are excluded from negotiations.

item.title: Com live ao estilo Bolsonaro, Flávio aproveita decisão de Moraes para tentar se fortalecer
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro held a live stream in his father’s style, featuring a Brazilian flag, profanity, and attacks on the STF, Minister Alexandre de Moraes, and President Lula, following a court order barring him from seeing former President Jair Bolsonaro. The broadcast aimed to strengthen his candidacy, which had faced criticism for being too moderate within the right, by channeling outrage over the judicial restriction to position himself as the true heir of Bolsonarism.

item.title: Dino cita "oligarquia parlamentar" em indicação de emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino condemned the interference of party leaders without parliamentary mandates in the allocation of parliamentary amendments, calling it a 'parliamentary oligarchy' and a 'serious constitutional error'. He ordered the asset freeze of Valdemar Costa Neto (PL) and Eduardo Cunha for allegedly directing budgetary resources without legal authority, and gave the Chamber of Deputies, Senate, and Health Committees 30 days to present transparency measures.

item.title: TSE debate com empresas de pesquisa eleitoral o Selo Acurácia
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques met with electoral polling companies to discuss the Electoral Accuracy Seal, which aims to recognize institutes with the highest precision in vote intention estimates. The seal, still under discussion until July 17, would be awarded only in general election years and require polls to be registered in the official PesqEle system and publicly disclosed. Institutes definitively convicted of fraud or serious irregularities invalidating polls are excluded from consideration.

item.title: Seu Voto Importa: programa organiza transporte para eleitores com deficiência ou mobilidade reduzida
item.description: The 'Your Vote Matters' program provides free transportation for voters with disabilities or reduced mobility in the 2026 General Elections. Requests must be submitted up to 20 days before Election Day, either in person or through remote channels offered by Regional Electoral Courts (TREs), supported by self-declaration or documentation. Regulated by TSE Resolution No. 23.753/2026, the initiative aims to remove accessibility barriers to voting and is implemented in a decentralized manner across Brazil's federal units.

item.title: Dependência do pai fragiliza projeto ‘Bolsonaro 2.0’ de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro seeks to present himself as a modernized, vaccine-like version of his father Jair Bolsonaro, but remains dependent on the former president's explicit support to prevent internal campaign fractures, revealing a leadership vacuum in the Bolsonarist movement. His campaign is weakened by family conflicts, including public disputes with Michelle Bolsonaro and ideological controversies from his brother Eduardo, as well as backlash over sexist remarks and opaque financing. Federal Minister Alexandre de Moraes' interpretation of the father's letter as a breach of judicial caution further isolates Flávio, undermining his attempt to lead independently.

item.title: Lula fecha palanques em 25 estados e no DF com ‘sacrifícios’; Flávio Bolsonaro enfrenta resistências
item.description: President Lula (PT) has secured electoral slates in 25 states and the Federal District with support from historical allies and the Centrão, relying on "sacrifices" from the PT to define candidacies in 11 states. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) faces resistance and has defined slates in 12 states with PL candidates, plus center-right ally support in five others; Minas Gerais remains undefined for both candidates. The regional arrangements give Lula an advantage over Bolsonaro in the 2026 election preparations.

item.title: A carta de Jair a Flávio e a sensata decisão de Moraes
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes granted humanitarian house arrest to Jair Bolsonaro, but the former president and his son Flávio Bolsonaro violated the restrictions as a political strategy to victimize him and influence the 2026 elections. Moraes’ decision was deemed sensible, as it avoided sending Bolsonaro back to prison, where his death could be exploited as a mobilization tool by the family. The Bolsonaros attempt to manipulate public opinion by comparing their situation to Lula’s imprisonment, despite the existence of an express prohibition in this case.

item.title: Flávio muda estratégia após veto de visitas a Bolsonaro e amplia ataques ao STF para reforçar tom de perseguição eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shifted his electoral strategy after Justice Alexandre de Moraes of the STF suspended his visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The campaign will now adopt a harder tone against the Supreme Court, emphasizing political persecution to mobilize Bolsonaro’s base and turn a legal setback into an electoral asset.

item.title: Crusoé: Vídeo de Michelle foi mais longe que carta de Bolsonaro
item.description: The video of Michelle Bolsonaro's emotional outburst against her stepchildren reached a wider audience on social media than the letter from Jair Bolsonaro read by his son Flávio, according to an analysis by research firm Nexus, which examined 62 thousand Portuguese-language mentions. The former First Lady generated significantly more engagement and visibility than the ex-president's content, suggesting stronger emotional resonance or virality in her message.

item.title: Após bloquear bens de Valdemar e Cunha, Dino diz em decisão que lei proíbe 'terceirização e privatização' de emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the asset freeze of Valdemar Costa Neto and Eduardo Cunha, stating that former parliamentarians lack legitimacy to interfere in the allocation of parliamentary amendments, which constitutes illegal 'outsourcing and privatization.' He emphasized that such practices violate the Constitution, moral and legal principles, and may be linked to electoral projects, posing a frontal attack on democratic values.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Moraes proíbe conversa de pai e filho até às eleições
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes barred Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, until the October elections, a decision that sparked political repercussions and was discussed on the Meio-Dia em Brasília program. The segment also covered the U.S.-Iran crisis and Deputy Damares Alves' reaction to the ruling.

item.title: A mentira da polarização: pesquisas mostram que há, sim, desejo por 3ª via
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows that 36% of voters prefer Lula, 32% would support any candidate endorsed by Jair Bolsonaro, and 27% favor a third-way option — someone not tied to either major pole. This reveals a notable appetite for alternatives beyond Brazil’s traditional two-sided polarization.

item.title: Governo e oposição chegam a acordo e abrem caminho para votação da MP do Frete
item.description: The government and opposition reached an agreement to enable the vote on the Freight MP in the Senate, aiming to prevent the measure from expiring on Thursday. The deal includes textual adjustments in four or five points and the retention of provisions the government opposes, which will be vetoed by Lula after congressional approval. Key points of contention are the amnesty for fines related to post-2022 blockades and the establishment of a minimum wage for truck drivers.

item.title: Lula repete Dilma e segura imposto da cerveja em ano de Copa
item.description: The Lula government has decided to maintain current beer taxation during the 2026 World Cup and presidential election year, following Dilma Rousseff’s 2014 strategy to avoid political backlash. The Finance Ministry plans to shift the tax burden to the new Selective Tax only in 2027, with a 'smooth transition,' postponing debate on progressive taxation of alcohol and tobacco until after the elections. The move benefits the beverage industry, which lobbies to preserve advantages from the old tax regime, despite Complementary Law 214 prohibiting tax rates from being tied to sector-specific revenue maintenance.

item.title: Dizer que Bolsonaro é perseguido só convence convertido, diz chefe de comunicação do PT
item.description: PT communications secretary Éden Valadares said the STF's decision to ban Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting Jair Bolsonaro should not be a concern, as the persecution narrative only convinces the already converted. He praised Minister Alexandre de Moraes' ruling, stating that sharing the letter via social media violated judicial orders and constituted an abuse of visitation rights.
